meta.purpose: Static snapshot of mock / hardcoded data shapes used in this CRM app. For developer reference and schema discovery only — the running app does not import this file.
meta.summary: 35 top-level `app*` sections cover all main pages in `pages/` (see `pageRouteMap`). Detail routes `/leads/[id]` and `/contacts/[id]` share `appCrmRecordDetail`. E-commerce store orders live under `appEcommerce.storeOrders` (nested route `/e-commerce/orders`, not a separate sidebar item). Marketing sub-routes (`/marketing/segments`, `/marketing/forms`, `/marketing/campaigns/[id]`) share `appMarketing`. Subscription detail `/subscriptions/[id]` shares `appSubscriptions`.
notes: Paths like ./people/ and ./companies/ match public/ asset URLs in Next.js.
Some UI-only keys (e.g. React icon components) are omitted; use string ids where applicable.
Contacts in source app/Contacts/index.jsx use Math.random() for image on some rows; this JSON uses deterministic person-1..4 rotation.
appContacts: ids 205–220 use `person-${Math.floor(Math.random()*4)+1}.png` in source; JSON uses rotating person-1..4 for a stable snapshot.
Entity shapes have matching Zod definitions in schemas/ — import from schemas/index.js for API parsing and validation.
